name: caviarde
title: Caviarde
description: Mask PII in your clipboard before you paste it anywhere
author: gldywn

commands.name: mask-and-paste
commands.title: Mask and Paste
commands.subtitle: Caviarde
commands.description: Replace personal data in the clipboard with placeholders, then paste the result

commands.name: setup-detector
commands.title: Set up Detector
commands.subtitle: Caviarde
commands.description: Start the local detector Caviarde uses for its semantic layer

preferences.name: detectorUrl
preferences.title: Detector URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the local PasteGuard detector. Leave the default unless you moved it.

preferences.name: detectorTimeoutMs
preferences.title: Detector Timeout (ms)
preferences.description: Give up on the semantic layer after this long and mask with the deterministic layer alone.

preferences.name: authToken
preferences.title: Auth Token
preferences.description: Sent as a bearer token when set. A local detector needs none.

preferences.name: phoneRegions
preferences.title: Phone Regions
preferences.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes. Without these, only numbers in +33 form are detected.

preferences.name: maskPersons
preferences.title: Semantic Detection
preferences.label: Mask person names
preferences.description: Needs the local detector. Mentions written with an at sign are masked either way.

preferences.name: maskLocations
preferences.label: Mask locations and addresses
preferences.description: Needs the local detector. Street addresses are reported as locations.

preferences.name: maskOrganizations
preferences.label: Mask company and organisation names
preferences.description: Needs the local detector running the patch in detector-patch/.
